----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPLETIONIST - IN-GAME WINDOW
-- File: Completionist_Translations_UI.txt   (lines ported from the MCM keep their MCM key; plain text, no HTML)
--
-- Each line is:   KEY <TAB> | text
--
-- HOW TO TRANSLATE
--   * Change only the text AFTER the '|'. Never change the KEY in front of it.
--   * Keep the TAB between the KEY and the '|': a key ends at its first TAB.
--   * '\n' is a line break. Keep each one where it is.
--   * {} is filled in by Completionist (a number or a name). Keep every {} in your text.
--   * Keep '~~~ Name ~~~' headings exactly as they are.
--   * Lines starting with '-' are comments and are ignored.
--   * The order of the lines does not matter: lines are matched by KEY.
--   * Set your editor's tab width to 4 and the columns line up.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- About
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Settings help texts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeAlchemy_Info		|Leaves Alchemy Items out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeIngredients_Info	|Leaves Ingredients, including plants, out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeArmor_Info			|Leaves Armour Pieces out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeBooks_Info			|Leaves Books, Notes and Spell Tomes out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeMiscItems_Info		|Leaves Misc Items out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_ExcludeWeapons_Info		|Leaves Weapons out when scanning a cell.
$CellScanner_Setting_Pinning_ClearPin_Info		|Clears the assigned pin.
$CellScanner_Setting_Pinning_Enabled_Info		|Lets you pin a collectable item from its page or the Cell Scanner. A pinned item gets a quest marker and a glow when you're in the same cell as it.\nDefault: Enabled
$ModNotificationsBooksInfo						|Receive notifications when the player reads a book tracked by Completionist for the first time.\nDefault: Enabled
$ModNotificationsItemsInfo						|Receive notifications when the player picks up a unique item tracked by Completionist.\nDefault: Enabled
$ModNotificationsSpecialInfo					|Receive notifications when the player performs a special action such as activating an undiscovered shrine or standing stone, acquiring a new pet, catching a new fish, learning a new dragon shout or word of power etc.\nDefault: Enabled
$State_OverRide_Displayable_Name_Info			|Sets the text of the Dynamic Crosshair Tag for museum displayable items.\nTyping '...' into the box will disable this tag.\nDefault: Displayable!
$State_OverRide_Displayed_Name_Info				|Sets the text of the Dynamic Crosshair Tag for museum displayed items.\nTyping '...' into the box will disable this tag.\nDefault: Displayed!
$State_OverRide_G_Name_Info						|Sets the text of the Dynamic Crosshair Tag for valid collected items.\nTyping '...' into the box will disable this tag.\nDefault: Got It!
$State_OverRide_N_Name_Info						|Sets the text of the Dynamic Crosshair Tag for valid collectable items.\nTyping '...' into the box will disable this tag.\nDefault: Need It!
$State_OverRide_Occupied_Name_Info				|Sets the text of the Dynamic Crosshair Tag for museum displayable items where a variation is already displayed.\nTyping '...' into the box will disable this tag.\nDefault: Occupied!
$State_MuseumModeEnabled_Info					|Controller for Museum Mode support within Completionist. Museum items get their tags and icons even if Completionist doesn't track them.\nDefault: Enabled
$State_TreatOccupiedAsDisplayed_Info			|Ignores the 'Occupied' settings and treats all occupied item displays as 'Displayed'.\nDefault: Disabled
$State_MuseumItemsOnly_Info						|Only tells you about museum items and specials like shrines, houses and fish: other items get no notifications, tags, icons or Cell Scanner results. Pages and tracking carry on as normal, so turning it off loses nothing.\nDefault: Disabled
$CellScanner_Setting_EXCL_Highlight				|Click to remove this cell from the excluded locations list.
$CellScanner_Setting_EXRF_Highlight				|Click to remove this reference from the excluded list.
